findings.issue: Revision hashes include transcript cache statistics, raw request timing and absolute visual paths, so identical cached or relocated analysis creates a new completion event.
Reconciliation trusts a recorded revision and eligible_at even when the current artifact content no longer matches that revision.
Reconciliation registers completion without its deterministic outbox event; additionally a pipeline rerun can notify a backfilled revision whose eligible_at is NULL.
Completion metadata overwrites manifest.json directly; an interrupted write truncates the existing manifest after the database commits.
Read-only connection creation occurs outside error handling in both readers, so open failures escape instead of reporting unavailable or failing closed.
Readiness checks neither the required migration version nor the v2 tables and reports an incomplete v1 database as ready.
A non-object manifest, invalid artifacts mapping or unreadable artifact aborts the entire reconciliation sweep instead of skipping the bad job.
A completed status alone is trusted: absent, unreadable or out-of-root analysis artifacts can be registered as verified completion.

Digest can emit legacy revision 1 after a DB commit precedes manifest identity writeback; a known job with an unregistered manifest revision can also bypass registry eligibility via created_at/mtime fallback.

needs-human: pre-upgrade video.completed:<job>:1 and earlier hash-format events are not associated with the new canonical content identity; rerunning unchanged historical content can create another event. Historical metadata cannot establish whether a new hash represents the same analysis, so a migration/notification policy is required.

summary: Fixed nine correctness and data-safety findings with 12 regression tests, including stable content identity, verified atomic completion recovery, historical no-send eligibility, safe manifest writes and read-only readiness. Git Bash verification passed: 166 Python tests (164 passed, 2 platform skips), 21 widget scenarios and git diff --check. needs-human: choose a migration/dedup policy for pre-upgrade revision-1 and earlier hash-format outbox events; their historical records cannot prove content equivalence, and no push, deployment or real provider send occurred.
